sanskrit: kumbhamudrābhiṣekesyāt prārthane prārthanāhvayākālakarṇīkumbhanādabinduvismayasaṃjñikāḥyatra tatra tāṃ viniyojayetuddeśānukramādāsāmucyante lakṣaṇāni catasyāgraṃ pīḍayitvā ca dakṣahastāṅgulīgaṇaiḥsthāpayeduccaranmantraṃ māraṃ bilvāhvayā matāsaṃgṛhya dakṣiṇena tu muṣṭināvāmāṅgulyastathā śliṣṭāḥ saṃyutāḥ suprasāritāḥoṣṭhe vāmakarāṅguṣṭho lagnastasya kaniṣṭhikātarjanīmadhyamānāmāḥ kiṃcitsaṅkocya cālitāḥbhavenmudrā sā vācyānupadaṃ punaḥkaradvayenamālāvanmudreyaṃ vanamālikāviṣṇoḥ santoṣavarddhinībhavedeṣā vaktavyaṃ saśaraṃ dhanuḥbadhnīyāt kaniṣṭhāmūlasaṃśriteanāmāspṛṣṭasaṃlagnā dakṣiṇasya kaniṣṭhikāvāmānāmāñcabadhnīyāddakṣāṅguṣṭhasya mūlakecatasro'pyagrasaṃlagnā mudrākaustubhasaṃjñikāśliṣṭe śliṣṭāvaṅguṣṭhakau tathāgaruḍamudrāsyād viṣṇoḥ santoṣakāriṇījānumadhye karau kṛtvā cibukoṣṭhau samāvṛtaubhavedeṣā mudrā tatprītivardhinīsaṃproktā mudrā vārāhasaṃjñikāmadhyamāṃ tāsāmunnamyātha vikuñcayetsaṃpuṭīkṛtya prasṛtāṅgulikau tathā

sanskrit: kāmamudreyamuditā sarvadevapriyaṅkarīdakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhaṃ vāmāṅguṣṭhena veṣṭayetvāmāṅgalīrdakṣiṇābhiraṅgulībhiśca bandhayetkaniṣṭhike baddhvā tarjanībhyāmanāmikeaṅguṣṭhāgradvayaṃ nyasyedyonimudreyamīritāprasārayedakṣamālā'nupadaṃ ca varābhayekhaṭvāṅgapātravadvāmahastaṃ vāmāṅgake nyasetśithilāṃ baddhvā kiṃciducchiritamadhyamāmḍamarukā mṛgamudrā juhotiṣutalāntarmilitāṅguṣṭhā padmamudrā vivasvataḥmadhyā saralābaddhamuṣṭikātarjanīmadhyamāsandhinirgatāṅguṣṭhamuṣṭikāvāmamuṣṭisthatarjanyā dakṣamuṣṭisthatarjanīpāśāhvayā mudrā vidvadbhiḥ parikīrtitātalaṃ ca karayostiryak saṃyojya cāṅgulīḥbījapūrā ca prasiddhatvādupekṣitāpāśāṅkuśau nigaditau pūrvameva yathāvidhivāmahastaḥ prasṛto'bhayamudrikāśiṣṭāṅgulī tu prasṛte saṃmṛṣṭe khaḍgamudrikākaniṣṭhāṃ ca vāmāṅguṣṭhena pīḍayettarjanyā dīrghayāvāṇamudrikāākuñcitāṅguliṃ kuryāccarmamudreyamīritāmauśalī mūrdhni kṛtā daurgyeva sā bhavettathānīya tadagreṅguṣṭhakau kṣipetvīṇāmudreyamākhyātā sarasvatyāḥ priyaṅkarī

sanskrit: saṃhatottānā proktā vyākhyānamudrikāmaṇibandhasthitau kṛtvā prasṛtāṅgulikau karausaptajihvākhyamudreyaṃ vaiśvānarapriyaṅkarīmadhyamāmadhyage kṛtvā kaniṣṭhe'ṅguṣṭhabo (ro) dhitemudrā sarvasaṃkṣobhakāriṇīaṅkuśākārarūpābhyāṃ madhyage parameśvarimatākṛtvā tarjanyau kuṭilākṛtīsamākhyātā tripurāhvānakarmaṇitadbahistarjanīdvayammudraiṣonmādinī proktā kledinī sarvayoṣitāmtathaiva hi kaniṣṭhikebhavedeṣā tripurātoṣakāriṇīsarvāḥ aṅguṣṭhāvagradeśataḥadhaḥ kṛtvāṅkuśākṛtīsarvakāmārthasādhinīmaheśāni hastau saṃparivartayetsamākrānte sarvordhvamapi madhyamenāmnā mudrā sarvottamottamātarjanyaṅguṣṭhayugalaṃ yugapatkārayettataḥyojye sarvādhastādanāmikeparāṅguṣṭhe kṣiptvā hastadvayena tudhyānamudrāsyādvāsudevāhvayā ca sātāvevābhimukhau kuryāt bālakarṇyabhirakṣaṇesarvarakṣākarīhyeṣā kuntamudrā samīritā

sanskrit: tarjanyaṅguṣṭhasaṃyogādagrato bindumudrikāvismayasaṃjñā syāt vismayāveśakāriṇīaṅguṣṭhau saṃhatau kāryau hṛdi kacchapikā bhavettattvamudreyamuditā mahāpātakanāśinīsādhayamānastu trisandhyaṃ devamarcayetcittagatā kāryā kāryaṃ va hṛdayaṃsthiramnityaṃ gatvā vandeta svaṃgurumkuryāt saṅgamaṃ sādhubhiḥ sahatilakalkena vā kṛtītriṣavaṇaṃ snānamaśaktau dviḥ sakṛttathākāmyakarmāṇi tathā sādhusamāgamamasatyabhāṣaṇaṃ coktiṃ kuṭilāṃ parivarjayetsatyaiḥ prastutasādhakaḥkarmabhirnityaṃ niḥspṛho vanitādiṣupuṣpadhāraṇameva casmaraṇaṃ kīrttanaṃ keliḥ prekṣaṇaṃ guhyabhāṣaṇamproktaṃ maithunaṃ tantravedibhiḥdvijāñchūdrān striyo naiva spṛśettadāpuraścaraṇakṛdbījaḥgośuśrūṣādikaṃ caiva kalpoktaṃ vidhivaccarettantrānusāreṇa mantriṇāṃ hitakāmyayāpayo mūlaṃ phalaṃ vāpi yadyadyatropapadyatebhakṣyaṃ haviṣyaṃ śākāni payomūlaṃ phalaṃ tathāsitāsvinnaṃ dhānyaṃ mudgāstilā yavāḥṣaṣṭikākālaśākaṃ ca mūlakaṃ kemuketarat

sanskrit: payo'nuddhṛtasāraṃ ca panasāmraharītakīlavalīdhātrīphalānyaguḍamaikṣavammukhyāstadanu vrīhayaḥ smṛtāḥsarvābhāve'pi varjayetsatkulasthānajātānāṃ bhikṣāśīlo'grajanmanāmbrahmottaraṃ viṇṇurmadhyapatraṃ maheśvaraḥvahistīrthāt pragṛhṇīyādaparvaṇiviśuddhādadhikerāgādgṛhīte naiva sidhyatiyathā vṛddhistathābhuñjīta sādhakaḥparityājyaṃ duṣṭānnaṃ mantribhiḥ sadājalādvṛddhistaroryadvadindriyāṇāṃ tathānnataḥtathā kṣāralavaṇaṃ tailameva cagṛñjanaṃ bilvaṃ kalañjaṃ laśunaṃ tathākāṃsyapātre ca divābhojanameva casiddhiṃ nāpnoti sādhakaḥcāpi mantriṇāṃ hitakāmyayāvarṇamālaiva gadyate siddhikāṃkṣiṇāmsāṣṭavargaiḥ kliptayā varṇamālayāvairimantrā api nṝṇāmanye mantrāśca kiṃ punaḥvarṇayuktatvaṃ prathamaṃ varṇamuccarettasya siddhiradūrataḥvinā karma kṛtaṃ tadaphalaṃ bhavettistroṅgulyāstriparvāḥ syurmadhyamācaika parvikāpradakṣiṇamanukramammadhyamānāmāmadhyaparvayugātmakam

sanskrit: ārabhyamadhyamāmūlaparyantaṃ gaṇayedbudhaḥtu kṣidreṣu sravate japaḥyajjaptaṃ tatsarvaṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavetyasmānniyataṃ gaṇayedbudhaḥprakurvīta nityaṃ kāmyaṃ ca sādhakaḥtadvarṇasaṃkhyamālābhirjapamālā prakalpayetpadmākṣāḥ puṣṭilakṣmīdāḥ śatrunāśakarāḥ sadāracitā mālā saubhāgyaṃ vipulāṃ śriyamtanute tadvat sphāṭikyapyakṣamālikāmālā sarvān kāmān prayacchatikauśī rudrākṣādikuśāntakaiḥuccāṭane'śvadantānāṃ mālāḥ protāścabālakaiḥgrathitairnirmitāmālā śatrūṇāṃ nāśinī matākeśaiḥ protavyā dveṣakarmaṇiśastā indrākṣairaktacandanaiḥaṅgulījapasaṃkhyānamekamevamudāhṛtammaliratnaiśca daśasāhasrakaṃ smṛtamsvarṇairdaśaguṇā saiva sarvaiḥ śataguṇaṃ tathāśuddhapadmākṣamālābhirapisyādamitaṃ phalamśataiḥ kuryātsarvasādhāraṇe japeaṣṭottaraśataiḥ sarvasiddhiruktā kṛtasrajāpuṣṭyarthī saptaviṃśatyā pañcadaśyābhicārikepakṣayostasmādvikalpaḥ syādvyavasthitaḥmantribhiḥvidyāyādau sādhako grathayet svayam

sanskrit: taccandanasakāśena puṣpasrakparamiṣyateyathākāmamakṣāṇyānīya yatnataḥkīṭādibhiraduṣṭāni na jīrṇāni navāni vaidvijapuṇyastrīnirmitaṃ triguṇīkṛtamtathā kṛṣṇaṃ vaśyaśāntyabhicārikesthāpayetpadmaūpeṇāśvatthanavapallavāntāraṃ śaktiṃ mātṛkāṃ ca sūtrai caiva maṇiṣvathahomasaṃkhyādviguṇaṃ japamācaretmaṇimekaikamādāya sūtre vai yojayetsudhīḥgopucchasadṛśī kāryā yadvā sarpākṛtiḥśubhābrahmagranthiṃ prakalpayetgāyatrīmantrakathanaṃ brahmagranthiprakalpanevidhāyetthaṃ tasyāstvatiśayārthakānkṣālayetpañcagavyena sadyojātena sajjalaiḥtarpayet puruṣeṇa tupañcamenaiva tato mantreṇa mantrayetkṛtākṣamālāyāṃ japenmātṛkayā sudhīḥsakalamantrāṇāṃ japaḥ kāryo'nayāsrajāspṛśedenāṃ karabhraṣṭāṃ na kārayetspṛśetso'yaṃ muktido gaṇanakramaḥaṅguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ tu japeduttama karmaṇimantraṃ gopayecca nijaṃ gurumprakāśayedvidvān mantraṃ naiva prakāśayetbhūtarākṣasavetālāḥ siddhagandharvacāri(ra)ṇāḥsūtraṃ prayuñjīta na truṭyati jape yathā

sanskrit: japetpādāvutkaṭāsana eva vājapakāle vivarjayetśrute'dhovāyugamane jṛmbhaṇejapamutsṛjetsamyagjapeccheṣaṃ yadvā sūryādidarśanamśrīnāradīyakedoṣāḥ kathyante siddhibodhinaḥmanoryasyādimadhyānteṣvānilaṃ bījamucyatepañcadhāvātha samantraśchinnasaṃjñakaḥvijñeyo bhuktimuktivivarjitaḥprokto hakāro bīja saṃyutaḥmanuryaḥ syādrephārkenduvivarjitaḥādimadhyāvasāneṣu haṃsaḥ prāsādavāguraupadaṃ nāsti yasmin sa kīlitaḥmantraḥsyāt stambhitaḥ siddhibo(ro)dhakaḥtaṃ tu dagdhaṃ manvīta mantravitmukhena praṇavaḥ sthitaḥādimadhyāvasāneṣu bhavennārṇacatuṣṭayamvā krodho vā mūrdhani dvidhāhṛdaye śīrṣe vaṣaṭvauṣaṭ ca madhyataḥhaṃsahīno yaḥ suṣuptaḥ sa udāhṛtaḥpañcakādiryo madonmatta udāhṛtaḥvirāmasthānagaṃ yasya hṛtavīryaḥ sa kathyateityeṣa yaḥ syādaṣṭādaśākṣaraḥhṛllekhāṅkuśabījāḍhyastaṃ prasuptaṃ pracakṣateyuvā prauḍhaścatvāriṃśallipirmanuḥ

sanskrit: catuḥśatākṣaraścāpi vṛddha ityabhidhīyatehṛdayaṃ śiro mantrau ca madhyataḥśivaśaktyarṇahīno vā sa nirbīja iti smṛtaḥsiddhihīnaḥ syānmandaḥ paṃktyakṣaro manuḥśaktihīnaḥ syāccaturvarṇastu kekaraḥsārdhadvādaśavarṇo vā dhūmitaḥ sa tu ninditaḥviṃśatyarṇastriṃśadarṇo yaḥ syādāliṅgitastu saḥcaturviṃśativarṇo yaḥ saptaviṃśativarṇakaḥekādaśākṣarī vāpi pañca viṃśatisaṃkhyakaḥṣaḍviṃśatyakṣaro ṣaṭtriṃśadvarṇakastathāaṣṭāviṃśadakṣaro yaḥ ekatriṃśadathāpi vāmantrastrayastriṃśadathāpi vātriṣaṣṭiryāvadāpatetpañcaṣaṣṭyakṣarāyesyurmantrāste śāntamānasāḥnigaditāḥ sthānabhraṣṭāhvayābudhaiḥvikalāste'bhidhīyante śataṃ sārdha śatastu (ntu) vāyatsaṃkhyā nisnehāste samīritāyāgeṣu parityājyaḥ sadā budhaiḥdvisahasrādhikā mantrāḥ khaṇḍaśaḥ śatadhā matāḥvidyāśca boddhavyā mantribhiḥ sarvakarmasutadāvaśyakamevātra tadvyaktaṃ śāradādiketasya kalpakoṭiśatairapiśodhayedūrdhvapavano baddhayā yonimudrayāsarveṣu hṛllekhā kāmabījakamtārasaṃpuṭito vātha duṣṭamantro'pi siddhyati

sanskrit: śatrunkāmādīn yogamabhyasetduḥkhadānetānariṣaḍvargamātmanaḥyamaniyamāsanaprāṇāyāmāḥ tataḥ paramaṣṭāṅgānyāhuretāni yogino yogasādhanedhṛtirmitāhāraḥ śaucaṃ ceti yamā daśasiddhāntaśravaṇaṃ caiva hrīrmatiścajapodga(vra)tamvicaratāṃ viṣayeṣu nirargalamaṅguṣṭhagulphajānūrusīvanīliṅganābhiṣumastake mūrdhni dvādaśānte yathā vidhicaitanyāntaravartinānityaṃ devātmaparamātmanoḥyuktāhāravihārasya yuktaceṣṭasya karmasusamārabhya viśudhāntaranāḍikaḥliṅge vāmapārṣṇima (tha) nyasetkākacañcuyutakramātkarṇau tarjanībhyāṃ tu locaneaṅgulībhirnātidṛḍhamavarudhya svakaṃ manaḥsaṃtyajya purīṣantu punaḥ punaḥhūṁkṛtenoccārayedgudamārutampraviśyājagranthiṃ bhitvājapaṅkajamkramānmeghaninādābho jāyate tena budhyatevikasadbandhujīvapuṣpābhamujjvalamtayaikīkṛtamātmānaṃ yogī kuṇḍalinīṃ tataḥcitranāḍyā sahasradalapaṅkajamtatkarṇikāsaṃsthaśivasāyujyamāpnuyāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nipataṃtrīṃ(ntīṃ)mantramayīṃ lohitāmṛtaviśru(sru)timvṛtya prīṇayantī svasthānamadhigacchatimantrajāpavidhānena doṣān chinnādikān haretciraṃjīvetsmarātmakaḥpadmaṃ brahmaṇo bhūṣitaṃ dalaiḥprāhurmūlādhāraṃ tu yoginaḥśivasthānaṃ svādhiṣṭhānasamāhvayamdaśākṣarairdalairyuktaṃ nābhisthaṃ maṇipūrakamdalairādityasaṃkhyābhiḥ kādivarṇairvibhūṣitaiḥnalinaṃ kaṇṭhe'lirucibhiryutamśaraccandramayukhābhamājñānāmasaroruhamṣaṭcakrakamidaṃ proktaṃ yogaśāstraviśāradaiḥcakreśāḥ ṣaḍatra parikīrtitāḥcakreśāḥ kvacidevamudīritāḥceti kramāt ṣaṭcakradevatāḥhṛdibālā(ṇā)dvayaṃ liṅgamitarañcā(ccā)ntarālakesphuradraśmi triśṛṅga(ṅgaṃ)himaraśmikamdviguṇavistāravṛttarūpeṇa veṣṭitamśritābhāgaṃ tanorvāmaṃ tu dakṣiṇambrahmarandhraṃ tu citrā nāḍī tadantarejanārdano rudraḥ śivasādākhyakāvapitrikoṇāsti yonirlohitadīdhitiḥcintanīyastaḍinnibhaḥtanmadhye śivaśaktisvarūpiṇīprasuptabhujagākārā śaṃkhāvartabhramānmukham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yonimudrāyā bandha evaṃ prakīrtitaḥpaścāttāḍanaṃ bodhanaṃ tathāguptirdaśaitā mantrasaṃskriyāḥmantrīsauvarṇalekhinyā mātṛkārṇān yathākramamavaśiṭairmātṛkārṇaiḥ saṃpuṭīkṛtya taṃ japetkṛtvā mantravarṇān japetsudhīḥsamālikhya tāḍayeccandanāmbhasāsamālikhya prasūnaiḥ karavīrajaiḥaśvatthapallavairmantramabhiṣiñcedviśuddhayeyonibandhorddhvapavanastadutthajyotiṣā tataḥmantrī vimalīkaraṇaṃ tvidampratyarṇaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ manoḥtantre tarpaṇaṃ tarpaṇaṃ matamgopanaṃ tvaprakāśanamvidhinā mantrī yathoktaphalamaśnutedadyād varaṃ dakṣe niveśayetnavanītaṃ ca dadhibhāṇḍaṃ tathā guḍamvīṇāṃ tathā nāgaṃ vyañjanaṃ ca kamaṇḍalumpakṣiṇaṃ mudrāṃ dakṣiṇe viniyojayetpāśaṃ ca pustaṃ ca pātraṃ vāme vicintayetphalaṃ khaḍgaṃ triśūlaṃ ḍamaruṃ tathādhanurvāṇaṃ cobhayorhastakaṅkaṇaṃ mudrikāṃ gadāmarghapātraṃ cobhayostu dadyātpuṣpāñjaliṃ tathāsarvadevānāṃ pītaṃ viṣṇoḥ samīritamnṛsiṃhācyu vā nā go pe ha kṛ kramāt

sanskrit: siddhirbhavedāśu abhāgyasyāpi dehinaḥtathāsyāmukagotrasya puraścaraṇasiddhayevāpi krośaṃ gavyūtimeva vāmānaṃ kvacinmānaṃ na vidyatesthānaṃ krośayugmamathāpi vākṛtvā pratyekaṃ vai kadāpi vācāstraṃ samabhyarcya mantrī pañcopacārakaiḥmantrī na vighnaiḥ paribhūyatesvavargeṇa saṃpūjya vidhivattataḥsamāśritya kūrmacakraṃ vicintayetvargān lakṣamīśe madhyakoṣṭhe tathā likhetubhe pāṇau dve śiṣṭaṃ pucchamīritamhyudāsīnaḥ pārśvasthoduḥkhamāpnuyātkūrmacakramidaṃ proktaṃ mantriṇāṃ siddhisādhanamvāpi yatra kutrāvaloyankūrmacakramavijñāya yaḥ kuryājjapahomakamvidhāyādāvekabhuktaṃ samācaretsvarṇadānādikaṃ kuryādathavā sarvakāmadamsantarpayet samyak bhojanācchādanābhiḥpaścāt tadanujñāpurassaramsvagurormanasaiva samācaretprakurvīta haviṣyānnena taddinekṛtāvaśyakriyo dhīraḥ upaviśyāsane śubheparamātmānaṃ vyākhyāmudrālasatkaramdhyātvā ca tatpādasrutapīyūṣadhārayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hṛdaye dhyātvā dehaṃ svaṃ paricintayetvinyasetpaścān mantrārthaṃ saṃsmaranbudhaḥpaścātsvamantra-ṛṣyādinyāsapūrvakamādarāttattīrthaṃ mudrayā dhenusaṃjñayādhyātvā taccaraṇasṛ(sru)temantrī kuryātsandhyādikāṃ kriyāmmūlamanuṃ tvaṣṭāviṃśati pramitaṃ tataḥmūrdhni tadvatkalaśamudrayātripurādevi vidmahe padamīrayetityabhidhāyātha vadet klinne pracodayāttrailokyamohanāyeti vidmahe padamīrayetśrīhareḥ proktā sakalārthapradāyinīityabhidhāyānte vadedrāmaḥ pracodayātkāmadevāya vidmahe puṣpabāṇāya dhīmahigāyatrī proktā sakalasiddhidātanno rudraḥ pracodayātvidmahe mahājvālāya dhīmahigāyatrī proktā sarvasamṛddhidāpravadettannaścaṇḍaḥ pracodayātdivākarāya dhīmahisamuddiṣṭā gāyatrī sarvasiddhidātanmantradevatānāmnā gāyatrīṃ tatra kalpayetsūrya-ādityetyaṣṭārṇena ca bhānavedikpatīnnatvā tataḥ saṃkalpamācarethavanaṃ homāddaśāṃśaṃ tarpaṇaṃ tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: puraścaraṇamevaṃ hi kariṣye prāgudaṅmukhaḥkuśākṣatajalairevaṃ saṃkalpaḥ śāstradarśitaḥito'nyathā vadantyeke sampradāyānusāriṇaḥbhāvenāpyuttarottaraśaṃsitātribhāgahīnaṃ pakṣaṃ vā tribhāgaṃ tvardhameva vābrāhmaṇānāṃ tu na karmaviniveśitamjapasyaiva daśāṃśataḥdaśāṃśenāpi vidyāyā devatāṃ cintayedapiprakṣālayedgatvā tato maṇḍapasaṃnidhimsaṃśodhya hṛnmantreṇa prapūrya cagandhapuṣpāṇi niḥkṣipettāramuccarandarśayettatvamudrāṃ ca sāmānyārghamidaṃ bhavetvāme gaṇeśaṃ ca sarasvatīmdakṣiṇaśākhāyāṃ vighnaṃ kṣetreśamanyataḥvidhātāraṃ śaṃkhapadmanidhī tathātattadvārādhipān yajetpracaṇḍo'thabalaścaiva prabalo bhadra ityapinandisaṃjño mahākālo gaṇeśo vṛṣabhastathāvakratuṇḍaścaikadaṃṣṭro mahodaragajānanauvighnāḥ śākteyāḥ mātaraḥ smṛtāḥvārāhyanantarendrāṇī cāmuṇḍā saptamī tathāyamo'tha varuṇaḥ kuberastraipurā matāḥsakṛtsyāddvārapālāṃśca sarvāṃstatraiva pūjayetdivyāntarikṣabhaumāṃstu sarvavighnānnivārayetkṛtvā svāṅgaṃ saṃkocayan sudhīḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvārāpekṣaṃ tu vāmatvamityetannānu manyatespṛśedetadvyākhyānamapi mantriṇāmnārācāstradhiyā budhaḥye bhūtāste naśyantu śivājñayādiśi vāstvīśaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ ca samarcayetye bhavantyatra sālasā mitabuddhayaḥjapamācarettānāhustrividhān budhāḥmadhuparkācamanasnānavasanābharaṇāni caprayojayedarcanāyāmupacārāṁśca ṣoḍaśasumanodhūpadīpanaivedyavandanampūjā pañcopacārikīprakṣālyapāṇicaraṇau supavitrakaraḥ śuciḥtīkṣṇadaṃṣṭra mahākāya kalpāntadahanopamagṛhītvāsya sthānaśodhanamācaretādhāraśaktimārabhya pṛthivyantāḥ prapūjayetṛṣiścchandaḥ pṛthivyāḥ sutalaṃ matammantrasya āsane parikīrtitaḥdhāraya māṃ bhadre pavitrīkuru cāsanamsvastikādikrameṇaiva ṛjukāyo viśedbudhaḥjvalitasyāpi saṃnidhānaṃ prakalpayetpūjayetteṣu gaṇeśaṃ ca sarasvatīmsthāpanaṃ caitat puraścaryāparaṃ matamsuvāsitāmbusampūrṇaṃ savye kumbhaṃ suśobhanamghṛtaprajvalitāndīpān sthāpayetparitaḥ śubhān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhūtvā vāmadakṣiṇapārśvayoḥguruṃ dakṣe gaṇeśaṃ purato'mbikāmmantreṇa rakṣāṃ kuryāt samantataḥ(rdde)na surabhīkṛtya hastakausaṃśodhya kuryāttālatrayaṃ tataḥjyotirjñānasamudbhūtaṃ satyajñānasukhātmakambhūtapretapiśācebhyo vidhāya tadanantaramprakṣipetparito vahnivigamāyātha sādhakaḥjānuparyantaṃ caturasraṃ savajrakamjānvorānābhi candrārdhanibhaṃ padmena lāñchitamkaṇṭhaparyantaṃ trikoṇaṃ raktavarṇakamkaṇṭhādbhrūmadhyaparyantaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ vāyostu maṇḍalambhrūmadhyādbrahmarandhrāntaṃ vartulaṃ dhvajalāñchitamdhyātvā punastāni būtāni pravilāpayettathākāśe ākāśaṃ prakṛtau punaḥparabrahmarūpastiṣṭhet kiyatkṣaṇamsā mātṛkā prakṛtiḥparāsamīraṇādabhūdagnirvahnerāpastato mahīdevatārādhanenaivamutpannamiti cintayetsamastadevatārūpaṃ sarvadevamayaṃ vibhummukhyā bhūtasuddhirudīritāsarvamantranidānaṃ tu guṇatrayavivarjitamdvādaśāntapade nītvā sthāṇuvadbhāvayedvapuḥhṛdayasthena dahechuṣkaṃ kalevaramsaṃpūrṇamaṇḍalaṃ śubhraṃ cintayedamṛtātmakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: apivarṇamayaiścaiva pañcabhūtātmakaṃ vapuḥbhūtānāṃ dehe sve paricintayetbhūtaśuddhirvidhīyateaiśvaryāṣṭadalaṃ caiva paraṃ vairāgyakarṇikamtatkarṇikāsaṃsthaṃ pradīpakalikānibhamso'haṃ mantreṇa sādhakaḥtvakcakṣūrasanaghrāṇamukhapāṇipuraḥsaramrasaṃ ca gandhaṃ ca vāgādāne gatiṃ tathābījabhāvena tatra līnāni cintayetkandagatairvātairekībhūtaṃ nabhasvatamśarīraṃ sthiradhīrdakṣiṇena tu recayetvilīnapavanaṃ vahnimaṇḍalasaṃsthitamdhyāyedanalasampūrṇāṃ kumbhake recake ca tāmcaivaṃ niścalāṅgo jitendriyaḥpāthomaṇḍalasthamamṛtenaikatāṃ gatamprajapa - [nnatha kinnahi rūpyatekiñcātramantrajāpeṣu dhyānamva niyāmakamśāradādinibandha svaraso yataḥviśeṣavidhimutsṛjya taduktaṃ śāradādikevikalpaḥ kiṃ na kalpyatecaitat] kumbhake varṇamiśritāmśarīradoṣajātāni viśleṣaṃ kārayettanumvāyuṃ dakṣeṇa recayetprāṇāyāmaḥ sa vijñeyastarjanīmadhyame vinābāhyādāpūraṇaṃ vāyorudare pūrako mataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bahiryadrecanaṃ vāyorudarā (dre) cakopi saḥtadvigarbhaṃ ca taddvayaṃ kathyate yathāvigarbhaṃ ca yogaśāstraviśāradāḥṣoḍaśadhājapyāt kumbhake taccaturguṇamhastaḥ svaṃ jānumaṇḍalamkramāttasya vyatyāsena samācaretśanairevaṃ punaḥ punaḥcalito vāyuranyathā hanti sādhakamsarvarogasamudbhavaḥvividhā rogāḥ prāṇāyāma vyatikramāttattvāni svasvasthānaṃ samānayetprāhurna svadehaṃ viśodhayetbrahmahatyāśiraskaṃ ca svarṇasteyabhujadvayamtatsaṃyogipadadvandvamaṅgapratyaṅga pātakamkhaḍgacarmadharaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kukṣau dakṣiṇataḥ smaretproktā yogaśāstraviśāradaiḥjīvaṃ puṣkarasthe sadāśivegātraṃ sarvaṃ tadbhasma vāyunābalabhidā svamātmānaṃ vicintayetbudbudamadhyasthaṃ prasphuratkāntimaṇḍalamramyaṃ tadantaścintayedbudhaḥyatamanāścintayennīpakānanammārttaṇḍamaṇḍalaruciṃ caturdvārasuśobhanamudyadindudyutisitaṃ vitānavaralāñchitamparivāreṇa kṣetreśvara gaṇeśvarau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tato'ntaramarastrīṇāṃ gaṇān dhyāyedanākulaḥtasya padmamaṣṭadalaṃ budhaḥsvāsanasthāṃ cintayitveṣṭadevatāmanyatrāpyevamevasyādyadrūpāṃ sveṣṭadevatāmsādhako haṃsarūpiṇamproktā tattvajñairmāntrikottamaiḥsādhakavaro devatārādhanodyataḥbhūtaśuddhiṃ vinā karturjapahomārcanakriyāḥprāṇapratiṣṭhayā paścājjīvaṃ dehe nidhāpayetsthāpayeduktamantreṇa yathāvaditi māntrikāḥsarvamantrāṇāṃ vinyāsena vinā lipeḥvinā japaṃ prāhuḥ niṣphalaṃ sakalāsuramsamākhyātā devatā deśikottamaiḥvidheyāni jātiyuktāni deśikaiḥoṣṭhadantottamāṅgāsye doḥpatsaṃdhyagrakeṣu caca hṛtpūrvaṃ pāṇipādayuge tataḥsarveṣu hṛtpūrvatvasamanvayaḥmātrikāyā vinyāse'pīti kecananaitatsamāsākrāntatvāt pṛthaganvayavaiśasāt]sargarbindvantikāṃ nyaset ṭārṇādyāṃ sthitivartmanāsarvaṃkartumaśaktaścet sṛṣṭimātraṃ lipiṃ nyasettato jñeyo pūjanādiṣu mantribhiḥkāritā gamyate tayoḥpratyekādubhayorāvaśyakatvamiti gamyatecaturṇāmapi kīrtanāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: snānasaṃdhyādikepyevamanityatvaṃ bhaviṣyaticedvācyaṃ tattvanyāse'pi kā gatiḥvaiṣṇavītantre tattvanyāsaṃ vidurbudhāḥmanuvaryeṇa yaṃ mantraṃ japtumicchatiśūdraiśca kartavyo laukikenāsusaṃyamaḥpūrvoktā saṃkhyā'śaktasya cānyathāyuktaṃ tyajedenamevaṃ siddhimavāpnuyātkumbhakaśtaccaturguṇaḥrecakādikameke'tra prāṇāyāme kramaṃ viduḥtadasatpūrakābhāve recakānupapattitaḥiḍayākarṣayedvāyuṃ bāhyaṃ ṣoḍaśamātrayāprāṇāyāmamimaṃ prāhuriti ca kramabodhanātkiṃca śeṣe pavanasaṃyameputrayācanamtataścamātṛkāṃ nyasyediti tantreṣu keṣucitsayorūrvoradharmādīn pravinyasetpīṭhamantrāntaṃ hṛdivinyasya taṃ smaretṝṣyādīnviniyogāvadhi smarettasya tatproktamṛṣerbhāvastadārṣakamsaṃchādito devaiḥ purā mṛtyostu vai bhayātmantrasya taddiṣṭā yā tu devatāmantrāḥ karmārthameva caṛṣicchandodaivatāni śirovadanahṛtsu catatkalpasaṃproktairaṅgamantraiḥ karadvayenamaḥ pūrva śirase vahnivallabhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: netrayorvauṣaḍityuktam astrāya phaḍiti kramātmantraśāstraṃ tathā coktaṃ prāptamantreṇa dhīmatājapatarpaṇahomārcāsiddhamantrakṛtā apiteṣāṃ sarvathaiva prakīrtitābadhnīyācchoṭikābhiḥ samantataḥdīpikāyāṃ vinyasetpañcāṅgamaṅgulipañcakeyacchāradāvākyaṃ tatṣaḍaṅgaparaṃ bhavetsaṅkoco bādhakena vidhīyateupakramānusāreṇa viśeṣaparatā bhavetvirahāttasyāstadabhāvaviniścayātvarmma netra pāṇitaleṣvapiaṅgahīnasya mantrasya svenaivāṅgāni kalpayetkarayoraṅgavinyāse'grāṅguṣṭhādyaṅgamullikhetprāhuḥ keciduttānavedinaḥtatkathaṃ tatrāṅguṣṭhādyullekha iṣyatelalāṭāderullekhastulyatābalātarthāsaṅgatirapyatra na tathā tannigadyatehṛdayenāto buddhigamyanamaskriyāśiromantreṇa cottuṅgaṃ viṣayāhṛtirīritā(jo')sya tanuḥ proktā śikhāmantreṇamantriṇaḥdevo gṛhyate kavacantataḥdṛśiyena syāttattejo netravācakamtābhyāmaniṣṭamākṣipya cālayetphaṭpadāgnināśrīgārgyasaṃhitāpyenamarthaṃ sākṣāduvāca vaitantre proktaṃ kaṇṭharaveṇatat

sanskrit: tattatkalpaviśeṣokta prakārānyantavigrahammantrī tattatkalpaprakāśitamgandhapuṣpābhyāṃ bindusrutasudhārasaiḥjapenmantraṃ yathākṣaṇambījamaṣṭottaraśataṃ japet praṇavasaṃpuṭamsaṃhitāyāṃ tu proktamāvaraṇārcanamdeveśaṃ parivārāṁśca pūjayettataḥ kuryāddai(dai) hikābhyudayāya vaimānena nāpyanuktirnivedanātprokṣaṇītoyaṃ salilaiḥ paripūrayetpādyaṃ kāryamācamanīyakamśaṃkhaṃ pūrvataḥ susamāhitaḥpātre pādyādīni prakalpayettāmraṃ kāṃkṣyaṃ pālāśapatrakampātramaṣṭavidhaṃ proktaṃ sarvasiddhikaraṃ paramṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulīpātramuttamaṃ parikīrtitamvasvaṅgulivihīnaṃ tu na pātraṃ kārayetkvacitgandhākṣatādikaṃ mantrī sādhanaṃ sakalaṃ nyasetlikhedyantrarājaṃ tattatkalpoktarūpavatdevaḥ prīṇāti pūjitaḥtāmre pīṭhe bhūrje paṭe bhuvikalpe tadā bhūpurasaṃyutamvidhinālikhya pūjayediṣṭadevatāmpūjādhāratayoktatvādāvaśyakamihocyatemadhyabhāge tataḥ sampūjayedbudhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ādhāraśaktiṃ prayajetpaṅkajadvayadhāriṇīmsamāsīnaṃ kūrmaṃ nīlābhamarcayetmūrdhni dhārayantaṃ vasundharāmabhyarcayedvasumatīṃ sphuratsāgaramekhalāmpūjayetteṣāṃ vedikāṃ maṇḍalojjvalāmvṛṣakesaribhūtebharūpān dharmādhikān bhajetkoṇeṣu dikṣu cāthāmbujaṃ yajetpañcāśadvarṇabījāḍhyāṃ karṇikāṃ ca prapūjayetpadmapūjanamūciresauraṃ saṃpūjya taṃ tāpinyādi tatkalāḥ(uṣa)rbudhaṃ tṛtīyena dhūmrārciḥ prabhṛtīḥ kalāḥrajastamaḥ proktā ādibījaiḥ samarcayetyathāvidhi samarcayettathā madhye śaktīrnaṃva yathākramamkalpoktairathavā mantrairmūlamuccārya sādhakaḥkalpasaṃproktarūpāṃ dhyāyettataḥ paramproktaṃ saguṇaṃ nirguṇaṃ tathānirguṇaṃ dhyānamiti brahmavido viduḥsomasūryāgnimaṇḍalena virājitamtaddhi saguṇaṃ dhyānamucyatetattejaḥ suṣumnāvartmanā śivenāsikārandhramārgeṇa nirgataṃ sumanoharambrahmarandhreṇa mūrtau tasyāṃ vidhānataḥsamyak saṃsthāpanākhyamudrayānirodhinyā sammukhīkṛtya mudrayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paścādavaguṇṭhanamudrayābaddhvā vidadhyāt paramīkṛtimbaddhvānāmikāmūlaparvaṇoḥtviyaṃ cetsyātsthāpinī mudrikā matāpraveśitāṅguṣṭhā saiva saṃbo(ro)dhinī matāṣaḍaṅgānāṃ nyāsaḥ syātsakalīkṛtiḥgrathitāṅguṣṭhā prasārita parāṅguliḥdevatāhvānakarmaṇitu nityaṃ sannihito hariḥtattvarūpasya tejasaḥsiddhāntasārīyavacanasyānurodhataḥśivasyāvāhitasyāsya vidyāddehe'tra sannidhimprapūjyamānāṃ tu gṛhītvā nigrahādikampūjāyāṃ tānnidhyaṃ hi śivasya yatvyāptaṃ dhyeyaṃ syādavaguṇṭhanamsārdhamamṛtīkaraṇaṃ matamāvāhanādikāryāṇāmayamarthaḥ prakāśitaḥkesarāḥ pañcavargeṇa yaśanā (lā)rṇādikairapināstānāṅgalinaujñeyātadvat kṣoṇīpurasya vaip. 95) mātṛkāmbhojamākhyātaṃ sarvāpadvinivāraṇamsthāne sve sve mantryupaveśayetsamuccārya pīṭhaṃ tasyai nivedayetsyāt kvaca (kvāci) tkovā niyāmakaḥdeyaṃ kathaṃ syādeṣa nirṇayaḥniyamayatyekā parā sākalyabodhikā

sanskrit: dātavyaṃ jalamityavagamyateviśiṣṭo nāsticenmanuḥsamuccaredayaṃ mantro mūlādiḥ parikīrtitaḥmūrdhni śiromantreṇa saṃskṛtamśyāmākadūrvābjaviṣṇukrāntājalairmatamjātīlavaṅgakakkolaistaduktaṃ mantravedibhiḥsaṃproktaṃ vikalpastvanayordvayoḥmantrānnamonvitāneva taduktaṃ tatra mantribhiḥsaramuccārya pādyādīni prakalpayetnama iti procya dadyātpādyaṃ ca pādayoḥsyātpunastasyoccāraṇārthamidaṃ vacaḥcamanīyaṃ ca trivāraṃ mukhapaṅkajesvadhetyārādhyacaraṇāḥ pradīpe vyaktamūciredadhimadhūnmiśraṃ madhuparkaḥ samīritaḥgodhūmā vrīhīṇāmiva śālayaḥdadyādabbhirācamanīyakamabhyaṅgodvartanaṃ kuryānmahārājopacāravatkeśāngamārjanaṃ vastraṃ dattvā sūkṣme dukūlakesaṃsthāpyamaṇḍale ramye divyamālyānulepanaiḥmantrī tattatkalpaprakāśitammalayotpannamanāghrātaṃ suśītalampuṭitairmātṛkākṣaraiḥuttamāṅgahṛdādhārapādasarvāṅgakaiḥ kramātkaravīre dve kumude tulasīdvayamkundamandārapuṃnāga pāṭalānāga campakam

sanskrit: pāṭalābhā vajrādyāḥ parikīrttitāḥairāvatastathā meṣo mahiṣaḥ pretasaṃjñakaḥkramādeṣāṃ vāhanāni vidurbudhāḥvikalpenānvito bhavetihāṅgendravajrādyaiḥ pūjayediṣṭadevatāmprakurvīta tāmrakāṃsyādinirmitesārāṅgāraviniḥkṣiptairguggulvaguruvṛkṣajaiḥananyārpitadhūpo'yaṃ śasyate'rcanakarmaṇipradīptaśca vartyā gavyaghṛtāktayāśāradāyāmatispaṣṭaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ dhūpadīpayoḥdhūpayedājyasaṃmiśrairnīcairdevasya deśikaḥdarśayeddīpānuccaiḥ saurabhaśālinaḥpradānārthaṃ prārthayediṣṭa devatāmnaivedyaṃ mṛdu soṣṇaṃ supācitamkadalīpanasāmrādi dadhi dugdhaṃ prapānakamastrokṣitaṃ cakramudrārakṣitaṃ vāyuvāriṇāsudhādhārāpūrṇaṃ mūlāmṛtīkṛtamamṛtīkṛtya gandhādyairnaivedyamatha pūjayetsvāhāntaṃ mūlamuccārya jalaṃ dattvā nivedayetsarvārcāsu nijākhyayāvāmadoṣṇā vikacotpatrasannibhāmkaniṣṭhikānāme aṅguṣṭhaśirasā spṛśetmadhyātarjanyanāmikāḥvyānodānasamānāstārapūrvikāḥprāṇādikā mudrā darśanīyāḥ krameṇa vai

sanskrit: ṭhadvayānte ṭhadvayaṃ na namo'nte na namo vadetsamālokya saṃhitāḥ śāradādikammantrī tadvidhānaṃ pravakṣyatesthaṇḍile kāmyahomasya na vidhiḥ kvacitkarttavyaḥ sādhakaistatra kutracitgurvādīnnatvā bhūtaviśodhanamtattvanyāsādikaṃ kṛtvā tathaiva prāṇasaṃyamamekahastaṃ prakurvīta caturaṅgulamucchritamvālukābhiścaturasraṃ samantataḥmūlamantreṇa śareṇa prokṣaṇaṃ matamlikhellekhā hṛdā prāgudagagragāḥrekhāṇāmudagagrāṇāṃ brahmavaivasvatendavaḥlikhedrekhāḥ svaśākhoktā iti yallaghudīpikābarhiḥ syāttenedamiti kaścanasakesaraṃ tvaṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ tato bahiḥśaktimālikhya madhye sadhakasattamaḥmantrārṇaiḥ śaktibījābhito likhetpūrvaṃ kaumodaki tato bhavetvarmāstrāntāni nijamantrāṇi vai kramātmahāśūlaṃ tataḥ paramvāgīśvarīpīṭhaṃ tato mantrī prapūjayetbhuvaneśvaryāḥ śaktīḥ pīṭhamanuṃ tathādogdhrī aghorā maṅgalā navapīṭhamantro'yamāvāhyāsmin prapūjayetvāgīśvareṇasahitāmupacārairanukramāt

sanskrit: tattvasāgara saṃhitādiṣu pūjayetsaṃjātamāgniṃ tatra vicintayetsūryakāntādisambhūtaṃ yadvā śrotriyagehajamkiñcidaṅgāramādāya kavacāṇunākravyādāṃśaṃ tyajāmīti kecittyāgamihocireaudaryavaindavāgnibhyāmaikyaṃ saṃbhāvayanavasoḥdhenumudrāmṛtīkṛtamparibhrāmya pradakṣiṇamatandritaḥvahniṃ jānuspṛṣṭamahītalaḥśivavīryadhiyā devyā yonāvenaṃ viniḥkṣipetniḥkṣipya vidhivaddagdhvāsmin homakarmaṇimantrī vahnerdakṣiṇataḥ kuśekalpayedetānyaśaktau sādhakottamaḥpuṣpacandanatāmbūlasahitaṃ vāsasāṃ trayamtābhyāṃ dadyādācamanīyakamsamprokṣya yonimācchādya satkuśaiḥgarbharakṣārthaṃ mūlamantrābhimantritamgarbhiṇīṃ śaktiṃ rakṣa rakṣeti coccaranproktaṃ tatraiva tadihocyatekṛtvā tanmadhyeṅguṣṭhakau kṣipetjvālayenmanunānena tamagnimatha sādhakaḥsarvajñājñāpaya svāhā]kuryādagnidhamanaṃ kuryācca vyajanādināyaccoktaṃ laukike yojayanti tatprajvalitaṃ vande jātavedaṃ hutāśanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: trividhā rasanā vasoḥprāṇanetreṣu sarvataḥmantrāḥ samuddiṣṭā jihvānāṃ sapta ca kramāttataḥ śvetā dhūminī ca karālikākṛṣṇānyā suprabhā matāviśvamūrtisphuliṅginyo dhūmravarṇā manojavādivyapūjāsu rājasyaḥ kāmyakarmasusapitṛgandharvayakṣanāgapiśācakāḥkarāṅgavinyāsāvebhirmantrairyathā purāsaptajihvo dhanurdhara itīritāḥtanau tadvadātmano jātavedasaḥprakṣiṇakramānnyasyeducyante tā yathā kramātsaṃjño'nyastathā vaiśvānarāhvayaḥpadādyāḥ syurnamo'ntā vahnimūrtayaḥsampūjayenmantrī navaśakti samanvitamjvālinī proktāḥ kṛśānornavaśaktayaḥvaraśaktisvastyabhītīrdadhānaṃ karapallavaiḥjihvābhirvakṣyamāṇābhiryuktaṃ karmasu taṃ kramāthiraṇyeśe kṛṣṇā rakṣasi nīlaruktaruṇārkaprabhā padmarāgaprakhyā jale sthitāca dakṣottaranivāsinīhiraṇyā'karṣaṇādau syāt kanakā stambhanādiṣugaditā śāntā tūccāṭe cātiraktikāmadhye tanotīti na saṃśayaḥdarbhairagabhairmadhyasthamekhalāyāṃ paristaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhaṭṭanāgena tripurāsārasaṃgraheparidhīn prācivarjaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥekavṛkṣasamudbhūtānārdrānati-ṛjūn śubhāngṛhṇīyāt pūrvābhāve paraṃ paramca koṇeṣu jihvā bījādikā yajetpūjayenmūrttīḥ śaktisvastikadhāriṇīḥpaścādādāya pāṇibhyāṃ sruksu (sru) vau tāvadhomukhautadagramūlamadhyāni śodhayettairyathākramampratāpayenmantrī darbhānagnau viniḥkṣipetājyasthālīmathādāya prokṣayedastravāriṇāviniḥkṣipya saṃskṛtaṃ vīkṣaṇādibhiḥtāpanamuddiṣṭaṃ sādhakaistantrakovidaiḥhṛdayamantreṇa pavitrīkaraṇaṃ tvidamvisarjayeddarbhamabhidyotanamīritamtānnyasyet pradyotanamidaṃ matamaṅguṣṭhopakaniṣṭhābhyāṃ darbhau prādeśa sammitautadvaddhṛdayamantreṇa kuśābhyāmātmasaṃmukhamprādeśamātraṃ sagranthi darbhayugmaṃ ghṛtāntarenāḍīmiḍāṃ bhāge sakṣiṇe piṅgalāṃ tataḥdakṣiṇādbhāgādādāyājyaṃ hṛdā budhaḥvāmatastadvadādāya vāme vahnivilocanevahnerbhālavilocanetrinetrasadbhāvo vidyate nṛhariṃ vināvahnestrinetratvaṃ devatāpekṣamucyatesruveṇājyaṃ bhāgādādāya dakṣiṇāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhāgeṣvājyasyādvā (dyā) hutikramātkramādbhāgatrayādājyaṃ sruveṇādāya sādhakaḥityagnivaktranetrāṇāṃ kuryādudghāṭanaṃ budhaḥīśatatpuruṣāghorasadyovāmasvarūpiṇaḥmantrī nityahomaṃ samācaretpākaśuddhau ca vāme homaṃ samācaretiṣṭasañjananārthaṃ tu prācīnavadane yajettu tatraiva pañcame tu vimuktayesatārābhirvyāhṛtibhirājyena juhuyāttataḥgarbhādhānādikā vahneḥ kriyā nirvarttayetkramāttu mūlena garbhādhānādikāḥ kriyāḥsaptāhutīrdattvā garbhādhānādikāḥ kriyāḥpuṃsavanaṃ sīmantonnayanaṃ tataḥpaścādannaprāśanamīritampaniṣadaṃ paścād godānodvāhakau mṛtiḥsamuddiṣṭā vahnerāgamavedibhiḥgodānāntetyataḥ proktaṃ samāvartanamucyateājyāhutyaṣṭakairdattvā nāmakarma tathaiva catasya saṃpūjyātmani yojayetśleṣmātāpiśācatarusamudbhūtāḥ parityajetśleṣmātāpiśācataruṃ tyaktvā'nyebhyastu tāṃ haretjuhuyādekāmāhutiṃ mantravittamaḥkecinmūlamanoraṅgamantrāṃstantrārthavedinaḥsampradāyo'traśaraṇaṃ na kiñcidavaśiṣyatetiṣṭhannevāgnau sādhako yatamānasaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantreṇa juhuyādāhutīrdaśasarvamantrāṇāmetadagnimukhaṃ matamarcayedagnirūpāṃ tāṃ devatāmiṣṭadāyinīmmūlamantraiṇa vaktraikīkaraṇaṃ smṛtamjuhuyādājyenaikādaśāhutīḥjuhuyādaṅgamukhyānāmāhutīnāmanukramāttatastrimadhuropetaistilairvā kalpadeśitaiḥmahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ kuryādatha homaṃ vidhānavitpṛthivyai ca mahate ca samanvitammahāvyāhṛtayastvetāḥ sarvaśo devatāmayāḥvyāhṛtibhiḥ proktā mahāvyāhṛtayo yathāpūrṇāhutiṃ dadyānmūlamantreṇa sādhakaḥājyena sruvamāpūrya tenāpūrya srucaṃ tataḥṛjukāyastayormūlaṃ nābhimūle nidhāya caphalapuṣpākṣatopetamavichinnājyadhārayāśrīsomaśambhunā proktaṃ sampūrṇāhuti lakṣaṇampuṣpamāropya paścādvāmena pāṇināsamaṅgatordhvakāyaśca samapādaḥ samanvitaḥdurgādikāraṇatyāgādviniḥsṛtya suṣumnayāmūlamantramatasyordhvaṃ vauṣaḍantaṃ samuddharetbrahmārpaṇākhyamanunā punaraṣṭāvathāhutīḥprāṇabuddhidehadharmādhikārataḥvācā karmaṇā ca prabhāṣayetyat smṛtaṃ coktvā yaduktaṃ yatkṛtaṃ tathādvicā (ṭhā) ntoyaṃ brahmārpaṇamanurmataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: proktavidhānena jihvādīnāṃ vibhāvasoḥyojayitvā sve paridhīn saparistarānpaścānmaṇḍale balimāharetdadyādbaliṃ gandhapuṣpadhūpapūrvakamādarātmeṣādimuktvā nakṣatrasaṃjñāpūrvamanantaramcāribhyaścātha sarvebhyo bhūtebhyaśca namo vadetrāśyadhipānāṃ ca grahāṇāṃ tatra tatra tubalistvevaṃ samprokto homakarmaṇicaturasraṃ ca tadvidaḥpipīlikākārā mātuluṅganibhā apipaṅkajadalanibhā vā kathitā budhaiḥbṛhaspatirmanda śanigīṣpatayaḥ kramātsitaścaiva haritaḥ pāṭalastathāvabhruḥmalino rucibhiḥ kramātmānavastadvat kaulavastaittirastathāvidhivanmantrī devatāṃ paripūjayetproktamagnimukhaṃ mantrī nityahome'pi yojayetnityātkāmyavidherbhedaḥ sarvatraiva hi dṛśyatekimanyaiḥ śāradādikeśeṣānanujñāphalako nāto garbhādikā kriyāhomavidhiṃ coktvā śeṣe yacchāradādikeparidherviśeṣaḥ kevalo mataḥviśeṣastena homayoḥkāmye'pyetadagnimukhaṃ matamtataḥ kuryāt kāmya homamanantaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nitye'pītyavagantavyaṃ yacca vaiśeṣiko vidhiḥproktaṃ na tu vaiśeṣiko vidhiḥ]homasya vyāhṛtyorvādvayoḥ svakātnāstāñca nāḍī sandhānaṃ pratipakṣaśiraḥ svidamsaṃskāraśabdasya vīkṣaṇādi catuṣṭayeevāstāmanukalpe dva (tva)yaṃ vidhiḥādhānapūrvakālatvādvīkṣaṇādeḥ śrutakramebhūyāttanmūlāntarakalpanenirvāhādapi cādhānakarmaṇaḥtatra mantrapātrasamanvayaḥsaṃskāraśabdārthaścatvāro vīkṣaṇādayaḥbhaṭṭanāgenāpyamunā tu susaṃskṛtetadarthadvārabodhanātbhavedetannityeṣu na dahedimāntasmādetadvadhūmāṣamāpanenopamīyatevahnisaṃskāraḥ sarvasādharaṇo mayākāmye puraścaraṇakarmaṇividhāyādau sāmānyārghaṃ vidhāya camūlamantreṇa saṃśodhya saṃskārairvīkṣaṇādibhiḥvidhinā kṣiptvā prajvālya bodhayetsaṃpūjya brahmādīnagnimarcayetsamidho'gnau ghṛtāhuti catuṣṭayamāhutibhirghṛtairhutvā yathāvatsādhakottamaḥtaddevatāṃ vahnau vidhinā pūjayedapidaśāṃśamaṅgeṣu dadyāt pūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: japaṃ kuryuścaturguṇamkecittu homasaṃkhyāyāścāturguṇyamihociresaṃhitāderaśaktānāmityādau dīpikoditeviśiṣṭavidhigauravātsa home kāmateritāśaktyapekṣo'yaṃ vikalpo homapakṣataḥguravo'pyamumarthamavādiśanprakṛtatvena na tu jāpadaśāṃśataḥdīpikāvākyagocaraḥjapaḥ śūdre proktastannaviśāradaiḥkuryātāṃ homamityapaceṣṭatāpauraścaraṇake vidhautadaprāptiḥ sahomakesyādvirodhaḥ prakṛte bhavetcāmnāyamantrāṇāṃ sādhye syādadhikāritāanyathaivopapatteśca pūjāhomo (me)'pi sā bhavetmantraṃ na taṃ pūjā yadā bhavetevāstu puraścaraṇakarmaṇaḥsyādyadā home tayordvayoḥmūḍhavikrītagavāṃ rakṣaṇamucyatejapāddhomāt śālagrāmaśilārcanāttrayāṇāmeva varṇānāṃ home vidhirudīritaḥvāyavīsaṃhitā'pyāha sphuṭamarthamimaṃ yathātathaiva śūdrānāṃ praśasyeta na haumikītadā tatrāstu kā kṣatiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yadyaśaktiḥ syāddhome vā tarpaṇe'pi vādvayenaiva puraścaraṇa karma vaisāṅgasiddhyarthaṃ tadaśaktena bhaktitaḥca saṃkhyā noktā manīṣibhiḥsaṃkhyānuktau śataṃ sāṣṭaṃ sahasraṃ vā daśāpi vāsaṃmohane proktamanukte kāmyakarmaṇaḥgauravānmantrī tattaddhomaṃ samācaretcaitaduktaṃ prātyahike japeagastyasaṃhitāyāmapyeṣa vaiśeṣiko vidhiḥnāsti na vā prahvādikalpanamsyādityapekṣāyāmucyate munibhāṣitamvijñeyaḥ karmaṇāṃ pāragaḥ karaḥproktā aindrī saumyāparājitākartavyaṃ na prahvena na tiṣṭhatātarpayettaddaśāṃśena vidyānandakṛtāgametripurāsārasaṃgrahe'pi prakīrttitamvakṣye sampradāyānusārataḥjalenaiva pīṭhamantrāntamādarāthomāddaśāṃśato devavadane salilaiḥ śubhaiḥyojyaṃ mantrānte sveṣu nāmasutarpaṇaṃ vidadhīta vaividhānena daśāṃśaṃ śuddhavāriṇāsaṃkhyāyāṃ budhastvekaikamañjalimkecidicchanti parivārasya tarpaṇampadāttarpayāmi namo'ntataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daśāṃśena mārjayedātmamūrdhanidhyātasyātmano mūrdhni sādhakaḥmūlamuccārya kuryāditi cirantanāḥvakṣye tanmatasyānusārataḥsamāvāhyāsanaṃ dattvā mūlenaiveṣṭadevatāmpādyādyairarcayediṣṭadevatārūpabhūsurāntatsāṅgaṃ saphalaṃ bhavetbhojayedvidvān kṛtasāṅgārthasiddhayeviduṣo bhojayet sarvakarmasusyuḥ pathi rājñāṃ gajā ivajapamātrasya daśāṃśādeva cintanamvidhāyetthaṃ samyak sādhaka sattamaḥbahubhirvastrabhūṣābhiḥ pūjayedgurumātmanaḥdīnānāthāṃśca santoṣya mantrāḥ siddhyantimantriṇāmsnātvā saṃyatamānasaḥkuśākṣatajalaiḥ kuryāt saṃkalpaṃ devatāntataḥsparśādvimuktiparyantaṃ japenmantraṃ samāhitaḥpūjāṃ kuryādbrāhmaṇatarpaṇammantrasya jāyate siddhiruttamāsyātpauraścaraṇake vidhaudakṣiṇāmūrtimantre taditi tāntrikāḥtāvatpuraskriyāṃ kuryādyāvatsiddho bhavenmanuḥpuṃso viniyogamajānataḥsaṃhitādau yat prayogaḥ pratiṣidhyateprayogavidhiśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tathā lakṣmaṇamanoḥ kintu yāti parāṃ gatimmāraṇādirudāhṛtaḥprayogakartṝṇāṃ paraloko na vidyatebhaviṣyatītyanyatarabādhāvaśyaṃ bhaviṣyatisvīkāryaṃ niṣiddha viṣayaṃ hi tatnānāvidhavacobādhābhayena parikalpyateyatastadanyathābhūtaṃ tata eva samāpayetkuryānnāvṛttiḥ sarvakarmaṇaḥtadaṅgasyākriyā (yāntu) santu nāvṛttirnaiva tatkriyāśrameṇāpi naiva siddhiḥ samīhitāsiddhaikamantrasya nāsādhyaṃ vidyate kvacitvīrasādhanāṃ susamāhitaḥtasmātsarvaprayatnena kartavyā vīrasādhanāparataraṃ kiñcidvidyate śīghrasiddhidamlokoktyā tadvidhānamanuttamamsamutpādya madhumāṃsaguḍaudanaiḥsārdhayāmottaraṃ niśidūre dṛṣṭvā dhṛtvā kiyati paścimeācamyāñjalimābaddhya mantramenaṃ japetsudhīḥme siddhiṃ mamatvenānukampayācitādvāracatuṣke taccatuṣṭayamśmaśānaṣambha imaṃ sāmiṣānnabaliṃ vadetprayaccheti svāhānteti manurmataḥityuktvā imamityādiko paraḥimamityādikastvanyo dakṣiṇasyāṃ manurmataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantraḥ syāttato'nena nivedayet(maṃ) baliṃ mātardehi me siddhimuttamāmprāṇāyāmādikaṃ kuryāttato dhyātveṣṭa devatāmekākṣare'yutaṃ jāpo dvyākṣare'(ṣṭa) sahasrakamsaṃkhyoktā japānte devatā yadichāgabaliṃ dattvā varaṃ samprārthayedbudhaḥpañcavatsarādūrdhvama (ṣṭo)rddhvamiti kaścanacatuṣpathe tīre nadyā vā mṛtakaṃ budhaḥvidhivatsveṣṭa devatāmdadyācchāgabalintvante bhairave'nāmikā matāgaṇeśe tu madhyānyatra yatheṣṭa (ccha) yāmunibhirdaivataiścaiva kathitaṃ sādhakepsitamkathito'yamavekṣakaḥtataḥ prayogān kurvīta sādhako nijavāñchitānsaṃkṣepānnānātantrānusārataḥpañcagavyāni tatsamānaṃ manīṣibhiḥsyāttathā madhviti kecanamadhudugdhāderbhavecculukamātratāsruvālābhe nityahomādikarmaṇikecidityāhuḥ sāmpradāyikāḥpṛthukāstatpramāṇāḥ syuḥ saktavo'pi tathoditāḥcarumānaṃ syādikṣuḥ parvāvadhirmataḥkadalīphalanāraṅgaphalānyekaikaśo viduḥmātuluṅgānītyevaṃ kecidihocirephalaṃ bailvaṃ kapitthaṃ khaṇḍitaṃ dvidhā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: phalānyanyāni khaṇḍāni samidhaḥ syurdaśāṅgulāḥtvacā caiva na sakīṭā na pāṭritāsaparṇā na nirvīryā homeṣu ca vijānatāvidalā hrasvā vakrāḥ sasuṣirāstathāśrīsomaśambhurapyāha pramāṇaṃ mūlakādiṣugrāsārdhamātramannānāmakṣāṇi pañcahomayetbhāgaṃ juhuyādvidhinā parammuṣṭimātrāḥ syurmudgamāṣayavā apikarṣamātrāḥ syuḥ saptāṣṭau vā yavā matāḥścanaraktakalamā vihitā muṣṭimānataḥrājamāṣamitāḥ proktā ityanye tantravedinaḥproktāḥ karṣārdhārdhāstu sarṣapāḥśuktipramāṇaṃ lavaṇaṃ marīcānyekaviṃśatiḥcaturaṅguṣṭhamānaṃ syādvyañjanaṃ kṛśaraṃ tathācandanāgurukarpūrakastūrīkuṅkumāni caproktaṃ pramāṇaṃ candanādiṣukastūrīkuṅkumāni cahavirdravye tilājyaṃ havirucyatesahasraṃ syaddravyānukto ghṛtaṃ tathādakṣiṇāmūrtitantre tu prāhaitadgārgyasaṃhitāsmṛtidṛṣṭena vartmanāsamitpuṣpaphalādīnāṃ kartavyo mṛgamudrayāmilitvānāmikāṅguṣṭhamadhyamāgrāṇi yojayetsthitaṃ dhyāyet samiddhomeṣu sādhakaḥ

sanskrit: ācāryakuṇḍaṃ madhye syāda gaurīpatimahendrayoḥcandrārdhaṃ māraṇe yāmye tryasraṃ dveṣetu nair-ṛteudīdīcyāṃ pauṣṭike padmaṃ raudryāmaṣṭāśri muktidamabhicāropaśāntyarthaṃ īśe saptāśri vinyasetsadā home tathāśāntāvekaṃ varuṇadiggatamripuharaṃ tryastraṃ māraṇakārmaṇiviprāṇā rājñāṃ vartulamiṣyatecaturasraṃ ca sarveṣāṃ kecidicchanti tāntrikāḥsūtraṃ vinyaseddakṣiṇottaramsūtrāgramālambya madhyato dikcatuṣṭayevakragatāgrāṇi tatrasūtrāṇi pātayetyāvat pramāṇaṃ kuṇḍamiṣyateyonyādikuṇḍāni tāvatkṣetramitāni cavedonaśataṃ bhāgān nidhāya casūtraṃ pratīcyāṃ dakṣiṇottaramtayoḥ pārśve sāvadhānatayā sudhīḥsūtradvaye paścāttrikoṇaṃ jāyate tataḥvidyate tasya tvardhamānena sādhakaḥbhavedetadanyūnānadhikaṃ śubhamtataścādhaḥ sārdhabhāgadvayaṃ tyajetṣoḍaśāṃśonaṃ muktvā tatrāpi cihnayettataścādhaścihnamānena pūrvataḥkuṇḍaṃ śobhanīyamidaṃ bhavetpañcabhirvardhayedagre śroṇyāḥ sūtraṃ pṛthak pṛthakpātayetteṣu cihneṣu trikoṇaṃ kuṇḍamuttamam

sanskrit: sarvadṛṣṭimanoharampañcanavān madhyāt tena mānena vartulamtato dadyāt ṣaḍasraṃ kuṇḍamuttamampramāṇena karkaṭena tu madhyataḥaṣṭamāṃśadvayenaiva madhyato bhramaṇe kṛtecaturthenordhvabhūḥ kṣetranyāsatulyena ca kramātbhāgamādāya tadbāhye pañcamaṃ maṇḍalaṃ sudhīḥvidhinā mantrī tataḥ padmaṃ samālikhetviśeṣārthaṃ khananaṃ procyate'dhunātat kesarāṇāṃ ca maṇḍalamsamyagjāyante nipuṇastathāvibhaktasya bhāgaikasya trayodaśatāvanmānamitaṃ madhyasūtraṃ kṛtvānyadā likhetaṣṭau cihnāni kārayetsaralānyaṣṭasūtrāṇi sampātānītaretaram(tryā)śca sūtrāṇi koṇāṣṭādadhikāni camārjayedaṣṭakoṇākhyaṃ kuṇḍametadudīritamca yo viṃśopyaṃśastena samanvitāntāvadvyāsārdhamānena maṇḍalaṃ racayetsudhīḥjyāsūtraṃ śeṣamānaṃ tu kṛtvā pañca prapātayetdhanūṃṣi syurjyāṣaṣṭhāṃśaśarāṇi cajyāpañcakāvaśeṣāttu pañcāsraṃ kuṇḍamuttamamsaptana (la) vāṃstasminsūtre saṃvardhya tāvatābhāgairviṃśatyā viṃśāṃśo viśikhoyathānavabhirnavabhistvaṃśairmilitāgraṃ samantataḥ

sanskrit: puruṣārthaphalapradā(ṇṭa)kī samākhyātā vidyā varṇatrayātmikākṣeruddhā strī trivarṇeyaṃ vidyā vaśyatrikaṇṭakīmantraḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥnaśchando nivṛnnityā ca devatāravisaṃkhyārṇo mantrovaśyapradāyakaḥprastāriṇī proktā devatābhīṣṭa dāyinīvidyeyaṃ dvicāntorudravarṇabhāgsammohanaśchando gāyatraṃ tripuṭeśvarīproktastrayodaśabhirakṣaraiḥṭhayugalaṃ manuḥ saptadaśākṣaraḥtataścānnapūrṇe svāhā dhruvādivānannapūrṇeśvarī siddhā devatā samudrīritāmanurākhyātaḥ sarvavaśyapradāyakaḥpippalādo muniśchando nivṛddhūmāvatīmanuḥkarṇabindvāḍhyo bhūyo'sau sargavān bhavethṛdayānto'yaṃ mantro vasvakṣarātmakaḥdurgāsamīritāsadbhirduritāpannivāriṇīaṣṭākṣarī samākhyātā vidyā mahiṣamardinīdurgeyaṃ vidyā vedyā daśākṣarīvahnijāyānto manureṣa daśākṣaraḥmastrānte vahnijāyāvadhirmanuḥdevatā proktā samastasuravanditāsanetrenduḥ svapiṣisyādbhayaṃ ca mevadedbhagavatiṃ tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vanadurgākhyā sarvadurgavināśinīśaktirastraṃ vahnivadhūrbhavetśaktitritattvavāgbījaṃ tāramantrān samuddharetdvicānto'sau triśaktistāvadakṣarīchinnamastāmanurbhavetsyānmāyāyugmaṃ phaḍuccaretpañcabhirādyantamadhyeṣu militaiḥ pṛthaksamrāḍiha proktaśchando'syā bhairavaṃ bhavetviyattadādikendrāgnisthitaṃ vāmākṣi bindumatprathamaṃ bījaṃ kāmabījaṃ dvitīyakampañcakūṭātmikā vidyā vedyā tripurabhairavīdeśikairuktā devī tripurabhairavīcandrabījādhaḥ śivabījamiti kvacitṣaṭkūṭametatkathitaṃ bindunādayutaṃ kramātpūrvoktabhairavīmantre kāmakūṭe parā śivāmmādanaṃ bījaṃ śivamatra tridhā bhavetcādyayugmamantyaṃ visargavatṣaṭkūṭabhairavīvarṇān saṃhārakramato likhetḍāmareśvarabhairavyāḥ kāmaṃ hitvā sureśvarināma bhairavī samudāhṛtāceyamīśvarībhṛgusargāḍhyo manustārttiyamīritamtathādiṃ ca saiva śīghraphalā bhavettripureśānī bhajatāṃ kāmado maṇiḥcandreśavahnivāmākṣibindunādamayaṃ bhavet

sanskrit: kurutārttīyaṃ vidyā vedākṣarī bhavetsarvasaubhāgyadā bhavetdevatā jagadīśvarīvāgbhave devi nityakledini cālikhetvāmākṣibindunādāntān tārabījaṃ tato likhetākhyātaṃ devatā jīvanī bhavetṛṣyādi devī kāmeśvarī matācavargamantyahīnaṃ tu vilikhedvahnisaṃsthitamsyād bhareṇḍā devatā bhavetparāṃ vilikhya vahnyante vāsinyai nama ityapivasiṣṭhaḥ syādgāyatraṃ chanda ucyatekathaṃ (pharaiṃ) māyā candrabījaṃ visargavatgāyatramityuktaṃ devīvajreśvarī bhavetchando'syāṃ devateritāgāyatrī chanda ucyatekāmado maṇiḥmanumālikhetproktā bhajatāṃ kāmado maṇiḥbhedā noktā vistarakāraṇātbhuvaneśānībījaṃ tad vāgbhavaṃ bhavetrahitamādyādho madanākṣaramkāmabījaṃ mahodayamkevalaṃ tu viniyojya varānanepurasundarīprathamāyāstu vidyāyāḥ śaktiṃ turyañca sundari
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vidyāyāstārtīyaṃ suravanditelopāmudrāprabhāveṇa sākṣādbrahmasvarūpiṇīkuryādvāgbhave tu śivādyaṃ kāmabījakamsyāddakṣiṇāmūrttiśchandaḥ paṃktyāhvayaṃ bhavetmadhyaṃ ca haṃsayukkṣmākṣahendumat(tantre tu) trikūṭamidamuktavat]tato bālā śrīḥ parā ṣoḍaśākṣarīcāntarmukhaṃ kṛtvā vilikhettadanantaramsampuṭaṃ kuryādramākhyā parameśvarībindunādāntamādau vyatyāsato likhetṣoḍaśārṇeyaṃ proktā tantrāntare kramātpūrvavadbhedā noktā vistarakāraṇātparata īśvarīṃ yojayecchiveśakrabījasthaṃ yojayedbhuvaneśvarīmraktasaptamaśakrasthaṃ māyābījaṃ samuddharetdharādharasutābījamekatrāpi niyojayetcandrasaṃsthamākāśaṃ raktasaṃsthitamparadevatāsarvarājavaśaṃ paścāt karisarvapadaṃ tataḥsarvaduṣṭamṛgavaśaṃ kari sarvabhṛgustvarajāyāgneraṣṭāśītyakṣaro manuḥdīrghaṃtanucchadaṃ kālī manuḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥdvedhā tadante ca phaḍuccarettataḥ kūrcaṃ phaḍantā tryakṣarī bhavetnādavindusamāyuktāvevaṃ krodhadvayaṃ punaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ucchiṣṭapadamābhāṣya vadeccāṇḍālinītyapitataṣṭānto guṇaśaḥ sargabinduvā (mā) nvarṇaiḥ sarvābhīṣṭakaro bhavetmahāśvetāmanurasau samproktaścaturakṣaraḥsyānmuniśchando nivṛdvighno'sya devatāhṛdantorccāvidhauhomehi (dvi) cā (ṭhā) ntikaḥgaṇapatiṃ paścādvarānte varadaṃ padamaṣṭāviṃśatyakṣaro'yaṃ tārādyo manurīritaḥmahākālī dhruvādikākūrcayugaṃ māyāyugaṃ syāddakṣiṇe padamdviṭhaṃ kālīmanurdvāviṃśadakṣaraḥmāntaśca lāntonāntastathaiva caebhiraṣṭākṣarairmantraṃ śoṇapadmamiva smaretchando'nuṣṭubdevatā ca mahāmāyā manorbhavet(ttvāṃ) tārayormadhye vārāhītyaparā bhavetbhuvaneśīti saṃproktā bhavānyāstryakṣaro manuḥsargayogātparo bhavetmahāgaṇapatiḥ prokto devatā devavanditāpaścād varadānte vadet punaḥṣaḍviṃśatyakṣaromantro bhajatāṃ surapādapaḥvighneśvaraḥ prokto bhajatāṃ sarvakāmadaḥṅe'ntamagnivadhūḥ prokto mantro'yaṃdvādaśākṣaraḥtantre nāmnāśaktigaṇādhipaḥpūrvamuktāḥ syurasya mantrasya vai kramāthṛnmantraḥ svabījādyo daśākṣaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vighno devatāsya udīritātārādihṛdayānto'yaṃ herambamanurīritaḥsaptavarṇaḥ svabrahmaṇyātmako manuḥdurgāmekārāḍhyāṃ samuddharetsaṃproktaḥ suśrīvādirapi kramātṅentamucchiṣṭaśabdāḍhyaṃ mahātmānaṃ tathā vadetṅentamathocchiṣṭa svāhāṣṭāviṃśadarṇavānmāyānte namaścāṣṭākṣaro bhavetbhṛguśchandaḥ paṃktiḥ somo'sya devatāmarut śeṣaḥ sanetro'tristyapaścimaḥsavitābhīṣṭasiddhidaḥbhṛgurbhānostryakṣaromanurīritaḥtadādiḥ sargasaṃyutaḥgirijāpatiḥsādhayāgnipriyā tataḥṛṣirbhṛgurbhavecchando gāyatrī devatānalaḥlohitākṣapadaṃ dehi me dadāpaya ṭhadvayamproktā manorasya manīṣibhiḥṛṣyādyāḥ prāgvadevāsya devatā pāvako mahānsohaṃ svāhāṣṭavarṇavānsākṣātparaṃ jyotiḥ svarūpadhṛkmantroyaṃ prokto vasvakṣarātmakaḥdevī gāyatrī devatā viṣṇuravyayaḥtantre mantro'yaṃ dvādaśākṣaraḥprokto vāsudevo manīṣibhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāsudevāya hṛdantaḥ praṇavādikaḥdevatā dadhivāmanaḥsarvavāgīśvaretyante pravadedīśvaretyathamantrastārādirīritaḥdevatā syāddhayagrīvo vāgaiśvaryapradāyakaḥṣaḍakṣaro'yamādiṣṭaḥ bhajatāṃ kāmado maṇiḥsamākhyāto rāmo rākṣasamardanaḥmanurasau bhajatāṃ kāmado maṇiḥmantrastantravidbhirudīritaḥsvāhānto'ṅgaphaḍantaśca namo'ntaśca ṣaḍarṇavānrāmaśabdaścaturthyanto namaḥ pañcākṣaro manuḥmanurasau kathitaṃ tantravedibhiḥrāmabhadrapade'pyevamudito'ṣṭākṣro manuḥcandrabhadrāntaṃ sacaturthaṃ navākṣaramnoktā vistarakāraṇātsyātpataye tadanantaramvahnijāyāvadhirmantraḥ syāttrayastriṃśadakṣaraḥdevatādivarāho'sya mantrasya kathito budhaiḥdvandvaṃ dviṭhānto'yaṃ dhruvādikaḥproktaśchando nivṛdudāhṛtamdevatā sarvabhūtānāṃ prakṛtirdharaṇīmatāpadamābhāṣya sarvatomukhamīrayetnamāmyahamayaṃ prokto mantrarājaḥ suradrumaḥnarasiṃho'sya surāsuranamaskṛtaḥbindunādalasanmūrdhā bījaṃ naraharerviduḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00229 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paścāddīptadaṃṣṭrāyatatparamsarvabhūtavināśānte la(na) kāro bindumān marutsaptaṣaṣṭyakṣaraiḥ prokto jvālāmālī mahāmanuḥnarahareḥ kathitaḥ sarvakāmadaḥnarasiṃho'sya mantrasya samudīritaḥkavacāstrānto mantraḥ saptākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥmunibhiḥ proktaścakrarūpī hariḥ svayamgopījanapadasyānte vallabhāya dviṭhāvadhiḥsarvakāmaphalapradaḥkaṃsaniṣūdanaḥmanobhuvaḥ proktaṃ jagattritayamohanamsākṣāddevatā makaradhvajaḥmukundaścarṣipūrvakaḥnama ityaparomanuḥsiddhayaḥ sarvāḥ syurjapādyairihāmunākṛṣṇarūpanamodvandvamannādhipataye namaḥnārado'nuṣṭubannādhipatayo'syarṣipūrvakāḥṛṣyādyā brahma-gāyatrī-grahaghnaharayaḥ kramātviṣṇave prabhaviṣṇavechando'nuṣṭubdevatāsya śrīkṛṣṇaḥ parikīrttitaḥvarmāstraśirāṃsyaṣṭādaśākṣaraḥdevakīputramityuktvānnṛtyaśabdataḥkāliyamardanaḥgāyatrī chandaḥ kṛṣṇastu devatāramā gopījanavallabha ṅeśiraḥ

sanskrit: aṣṭādaśārṇavatsarvamaṅgarṣyādikamūhayetravyarṇobrahmagāyatrīkṛṣṇarṣyādiranukramātevādau syāccecchaktiramānvitaḥmanuvarṇānāmaṅgarṣyādi daśārṇavatṛṣyādyaṣṭādaśārṇoktaṃ manorasya yathākramātnandānte vapuṣe'styagnimāyānto daśavarṇakaḥnandaputrapadaṃ ṅentaṃ śyāmalāṅgapadaṃ tathāṛṣiśchandaścoṣṇiganuṣṭubhauṣoḍaśārṇo'yaṃ rukmiṇīvallabhāhvayaḥchando'nuṣṭubdevatā ca rukmiṇīvallabho hariḥdaṇḍānte bālarūpeti meghaśyāmapadaṃ tataḥca nī (lī) lādaṇḍaharirmataḥmāṃsayugantāya śiraḥ saptākṣaro manuḥuṣṇigdevatā ca govallabha udīritaḥdvandvaṃ dvādaśārṇo'yamīritaḥśārṅgī cakrī dakṣiṇakarṇayukṛṣirbrahmāsya gāyatrī chandaḥ kṛṣṇastu devatāśrīṃ siddha gopālako manuḥdvayakṣaraḥ kāmapūrvastryarṇaḥ sa eva cetvakṣyate pañcavarṇaḥ syātkṛṣṇāya nama ityapigopālāyāgnijāyāntaḥ ṣaḍakṣara udāhṛtaḥnamo'nto'nyaḥ kṛṣṇagovindakaḥ punaḥśrīśaktimārāḥ kṛṣṇāya māraḥ saptākṣaro'paraḥdadhibhakṣaṇaṅevahnijāyamiraparoṣṭakaḥmūlamantraśca navārṇaḥ smarasaṃpuṭaḥ

sanskrit: gāyatrī devatā kṛṣṇa īritaḥmāṃsādho raktaṃ cedaparo manuḥśikhivāmākṣiśaśikhaṇḍavibhūṣitāḥkrīḍāsaktapraśabdānte vadenmucetasekṛṣṇapadaṃ cekṣukārmukānte daśākṣaraḥkramotkramavaśād dvipañcāśallipirmanuḥṛṣiśchando virāḍbhavetsākṣilānto latānvito marutvāmadevo ṛṣiśchandaḥ paṃktirīśo'sya devatāṛṣiśchandaḥ purā prokto devatā syādumāpatiḥpaṃktirdevaḥ sadāśivaḥvasuvarṇo manurmataḥnigaditomantro mṛtyuñjayātmakaḥdevatāsya samīritaḥvaṭamūlapadasyānte padaṃpaścānnivāsinemantraḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥdakṣiṇāmūrttināmāsya devatā śambhurīritaḥdakṣiṇāmūrttiṃ mahyaṃ medhāmudīrayetdakṣiṇāmūrttirākhyāto vedavyākhyānatatparaḥbahnibījasthā dīrghā śāntīndubhūṣitānīlakaṇṭhātmakaḥ prokto viṣadvayaharaḥ paraḥkhyātaṃ bījaṃ sarvasamṛddhidamprokto devatā jagatāṃ patiḥtumbarūbījantadyena sidhyanti sādhakāḥghoraghorataretyante tanurūpapadaṃ tataḥ

sanskrit: ramadvandvaṃ tato bandhayugaṃ punaḥekapañcāśadarṇo'yamaghorāstramahāmanuḥsaṃdiṣṭo devatāmantravittamaiḥkarṇayuto varmāstrāntaḥ ṣaḍakṣaraḥvasuvarṇo'yaṃ kṣetrapālasya kīrtitaḥśaktiruddho mahāmanuḥphaḍantaścaṇḍamantro'yaṃ trivarṇāntaḥ samīritaḥdevatā prokto deśikaistantrakovidaiḥdīrghasaṃyuktaścānte syāddvicaturthayoḥkukkuṭeśvaramantro'yamuktaḥ pañcadaśākṣaraḥmahābhairavamantro'yamuḍḍīśaḥ siddhisādhanambahavo noste'lasairaparigrahātca maheśānyā daurgāścaiva daśāparegaṇeśasya somasyaikamathakramātcatvāriṃśattathā'ṣṭau ca gopālamanavaḥ kramātśambhoḥ pañcadaśeritāḥsapariṣkāramālokya tathā sārasamuccayampūjāpradīpaṃ ca puraścaraṇa candrikāmmantrā * * * śrīrāmārcanacandrikāmsanatkumārasya nāradīyaṃ catuḥśatīmvaiṣṇavīṃ tadvattattvasāgara saṃhitāmśrībhuvanaiśvaryāḥ nayasiddhāntamādarāthayagrīvamataṃ tadvattathā vijñānabhāratam (bhairavam)gu * * * ñca tantrarājaṃ ca tathā vai piṅgalāmatamsiddhāntaṃ sāraśrīsaṃhitāṃ kramāt
